summary: The root كسل (ksl) in form IV, أَكْسَلَ عَنْهَا, describes the act of penetration without ejaculation. It implies that one entered but then withdrew without releasing semen.
lane: 4 أَكْسَلَ عَنْهَا ذ signifies أَوْلَجَ وَلَمْ يُنْزِلْ ; [ Inivit sed non emisit; ] (IAar, in TA, art. فهر ;) [i. e., أَوْلَجَ ثُمَّ تَرَكَهَا وَلَمْ يُنْزِلْ ].

headwords.def: كَسَّلَهُ , inf. n. تَكْسِيلٌ , said of satiety, It rendered him heavy, sluggish, lazy, indolent, or torpid. (TA.)
أَكْسَلَ عَنْهَا signifies أَوْلَجَ وَلَمْ يُنْزِلْ ; [ Inivit sed non emisit; ] (IAar, in TA, art. فهر ;) [i. e., أَوْلَجَ ثُمَّ تَرَكَهَا وَلَمْ يُنْزِلْ ].
كَسْلَانٌ Heavy, sluggish, lazy, indolent, torpid. (K.)
مَكْسَلَةٌ : see an ex. voce كِطَّةٌ .
